• Trial scope and success criteria

  - Success gates: average latency < 400ms p95 for live flows, 70%+ accuracy on intent extraction test set, and 50k tokens/week sustained for 2 consecutive weeks

• Trial logistics

  - If PO, what are your internal timelines for issuing an initial PO for pilot-to-paid?

1) Confirm procurement contact (you mentioned Priya Natarajan) — I can loop her into a short call to map required docs (SOW, order form, security addenda).

3) We will set the contract effective / billing date to your preference — common asks are billing to start on order signature or on a defined go-live date.

If you want, we can do a 30m procurement sync on Tue 26 May at 10am PT — I can book if that works.

Appreciate the notes, Jules — answers inline and a short commercial summary below.

On AWS Marketplace: yes — Redwood Inference is available on AWS Marketplace. That path typically shortens internal PO routing because purchases go through AWS consolidated billing; however, enrollment/setup on the marketplace side can take a few business days depending on contact handoffs.

PO vs Card vs Marketplace — high level:
• PO (direct): Standard enterprise route. We provide an order form + SOW; legal review is typical. Timeline: 7–10 business days on average for the initial PO if there are no unusual procurement clauses. Requires a signed order form (we can generate and pre-fill).
• Company card (self-serve): Immediate activation for pilots. Card payments are easiest but finance sometimes blocks higher-volume spend.
• AWS Marketplace: Best for organizations wanting to keep vendor billing inside AWS. Requires marketplace enrollment but then can accept existing PO flows through AWS. Good middle ground.

Billing start behavior:
• By default, billing begins on the contract effective date (the date the order form is signed). We can also explicitly put a billing start date in the order form (for example, set to go-live date June 1) — if you prefer that, we'll add the clause: "Billing will commence on 2026-06-01 contingent upon pilot success confirmation or the effective date, whichever is later."

Trial-to-paid gating suggestion (to avoid surprises):
1) Measurement window: 2 weeks of sustained usage meeting the thresholds above.
2) Qualifying signoff: Jules + Priya confirm success with metric screenshots and an operations runbook.
3) Contract effective date = date order form signed; billing start date = explicit go-live date if requested.

I've attached a short procurement comparison doc and a prefilled order form template (redwood_orderform_v2.docx) to speed the PO path.

Next step: I'll schedule Tue 26 May 10am PT procurement sync and include a one-page marketplace onboarding checklist. If you want us to prepare a DocuSign envelope with the order form prefilled for PO signature, say the word and we'll send it to Priya and your legal.

Thanks,
